result.title: Parallel Language Models via Variational Decoding
result.summary: Autoregressive language models emit one token per forward pass. This causes high inference latency, in particular as models are scaled up for quality. In this paper, we introduce Parallel Language Models (PLMs), which generate mutually consistent tokens in one forward pass by routing dependencies through latent auxiliary variables. PLMs are trained using a variational bound that reduces to an autoregressive loss plus a parallel decoding loss. Empirically, PLMs are on a faster and better Pareto frontier than autoregressive and discrete diffusion baselines. Pretrained PLMs achieve near-autoregressive pretraining loss on model scales of 80M to 3B parameters, and speedup follows a power law in model size. When post-trained, our 1.3B model matches or exceeds an identically trained autoregressive model on math, coding, and instruction-following benchmarks, speeding up inference $2.3\text{-}5.7\times$. Together, we show that parallel generation can be trained from a single training objective at autoregressive quality. We will make our code available at https://github.com/mandt-lab/plm.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Parallel Language Models：把 token 之间的依赖经 latent 辅助变量路由，使模型一次前向即并行生成互相一致的 token，并用变分下界训练（自回归损失加并行解码损失）；80M–3B 规模预训练损失接近自回归，1.3B 后训练后推理加速 2.3–5.7 倍。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本并行解码工作，其 latent 辅助变量与「自回归损失＋并行解码损失」的变分训练目标，可能为 LVR 中并行产生与监督 latent 推理状态提供方法线索，是否可迁移到多模态状态尚待核查。
